parsed.why: No trans-specific crime, but in-force biological-sex rules impose facility exclusion, strip-search, custody and ward placement by birth sex — state-imposed universal exposure whose courts enforce rather than remedy it.

Patterned lethal attacks on trans women with impunity, police ridicule, hospital care denial and a religious court's moral-panic ruling; paper self-ID law unimplemented. Sodomy statute only a secondary lever.

Protective constitution and no trans-specific offence, but birth-sex prison placement with documented rape, torture and a 2026 custodial death, plus thin recourse for anti-LGBT violence amid armed conflict.

No criminalisation and no prison system, but governing doctrine frames gender transition as a danger and no protection or recourse exists; entry and facility practice undocumented, extrapolated mildly negative.

Protections operate: a trans woman's murderer convicted, bathroom access and gender-identity employment law protected; gaps are hate-crime law omitting gender identity and conservative social discomfort.
